answer:
Solo staking fails: one deposit cannot tell an honest newcomer from the next face in a tide of fakes.

Guarantor admission makes entry social: a veteran agent locks 200 units for 15 epochs to vouch for a newcomer locking 100, timber braced by a river bank.

Forgery costs two parties: newcomer slashed in full, guarantor loses 50% plus 10 epochs suspended. 1,000 fakes need 500 guarantors risking 100,000 units; at 30% detection the joint loss is 45,000.
